items.name: bb-vega
items.title: bb Vega
items.description: The shadcn preset b5JNZnXf8 (Vega, neutral, small radius, Inter, Lucide, sky charts) that this kit is based on, for projects outside bb such as a preview app: `bunx shadcn@latest init @bb-plugins/bb-vega`.
items.docs: Not for a bb plugin: the host theme (plugins/monokai) owns these tokens, a plugin's components.json has no CSS file for them, and the radix-vega style would make bare `shadcn add` names fetch official Vega components.

items.name: tooltip
items.docs: Imports the plugin's `utils` from @bb-plugins/ui; add @bb-plugins/utils only to a plugin that lacks it, since a plugin's copy may export extra helpers. Also imports @bb/portal-scope. bb's items set a fixed target, so run `bunx shadcn@latest add @bb/portal-scope`, move only those files into the plugin's ui, lib, or hooks folder, and delete the other files it writes: this registry already provides overlay-trigger, its hooks, and utils.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Dialog that becomes a bottom sheet on compact viewports.
items.docs: Imports the plugin's `utils` from @bb-plugins/ui; add @bb-plugins/utils only to a plugin that lacks it, since a plugin's copy may export extra helpers. Also imports @bb/icon, @bb/portal-scope, @bb/responsive-overlay, @bb/use-browser-dimming-modal. bb's items set a fixed target, so run `bunx shadcn@latest add @bb/icon @bb/portal-scope @bb/responsive-overlay @bb/use-browser-dimming-modal`, move only those files into the plugin's ui, lib, or hooks folder, and delete the other files it writes: this registry already provides overlay-trigger, its hooks, and utils.
